story: At 6:17 on a sunny Monday evening in Sumter Oaks, Gary is out in his garage rechecking the light harness and speaker mounts on his golf cart, patient as ever. Donna is optimistic as she heads down Magnolia Loop, and Hal, feeling content, has arrived at Rosa's house right on time. Rosa, warm as the evening, is insisting he sit down to a plate of arroz con pollo while she asks him how Gary's filing is coming along.
events: Gary (gary golf cart): Re-check the light harness connections and speaker mounts, garage only
Donna headed to Magnolia Loop (the street).

gary.thought_process: I've already run the full garage-only test at low volume with the door closed, and the wiring is tidy and fused. The request is filed with Architectural Review, so I can't put the cart on the street or show off the lights yet. It's 6:17 PM and I'm alone at home. Rather than sit idle, I'll do one more careful pass on the cart's harness. Fresh connections and strain relief are exactly the sort of thing that works loose, and I want it dependable before the parade. Being useful, even to my own cart, feels good.

parameters.content: Re-check the light harness connections and speaker mounts, garage only

donna.thought_process: I already reserved a court for tomorrow at tick 426 and studied the ladder standings at 425, so the kiosk and board are done. No one's here to talk to. Gary's on his way to being ready, but he's not in sight. Rather than loiter, I should head out onto Magnolia Loop and track Gary down to firm up our Tuesday plan and maybe stop by Rosa's for that dinner invitation. Time to move.

parameters.content: Court is booked for tomorrow, so I'm heading out to find Gary and make sure he's got his paddle and his knees ready.

hal.thought_process: I just walked into Rosa's House and she's the only one here. I promised myself I'd keep my word about the notebook until Monday, and it's Monday evening, so tonight is for friends, not filing. Rosa wanted us all together, so the polite thing is to greet her, ask if I can help, and see whether Donna and Gary are on their way. No reason to bring up the bulletin board or the committee at her table.

parameters.content: Evening, Rosa. I'm right on time. Anything I can carry to the table before the others show up?

rosa.thought_process: Hal just walked in while I'm at the house, and I've got arroz con pollo going for the neighbors. The dinner I planned is Friday with Hal, Gary, and Donna, and I already invited Gary. I don't want to re-ask anyone. Hal's here, so the natural move is to welcome him, tell him dinner's cooking, and keep Wednesday coffee in the open without pestering him. Keep it short and warm, then let him respond.

parameters.content: Hal, perfect timing, there's a big pot of arroz con pollo on and I'm not letting you leave without a plate. Sit, tell me how Gary's filing is looking while it finishes.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
